title: Ather 450X Gen 3 Pro Apex (Classic Heritage)
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Ather Energy Ather 450X Gen 3 Pro Apex (Classic Heritage) is engineered for relaxed boulevard cruising backed by muscular roll-on passing power. At its heart lies a 450cc powertrain delivering 44 HP and 38 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 163 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Step-Through Upright posture paired with an accessible 765mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights, backed by a 14L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
